Work Experience 
Business Analyst Experience
Deloitte | Business Analyst / Consultant Jan 2026 – Present
•
• • • •
Support business readiness and change activities for enterprise application enhancements and production releases. Coordinate across business stakeholders, Product Owners, developers, testers and support teams to ensure successful project delivery. Track issues, risks, dependencies and change requests, ensuring timely resolution and stakeholder communication. Support SIT, UAT, defect management and deployment readiness activities. Prepare governance documentation, status reports, process documentation and stakeholder communications. Participate in release planning, production deployment support and post-implementation reviews. Contribute to process improvement and operational efficiency initiatives.
HSBC | Business Analyst
Project Title: HWS (Hong Kong Workflow System) February 2024 -2026 Duration:
Manual processing of Fixed Deposit instructions led to delays, errors, and reduced efficiency for branch and operations teams. To overcome this, HWS was developed as a centralized application for staff to create, validate, and manage Fixed Deposits online. The system supported FD creation with deposit amount entry, tenure selection, rate assignment, and debit account verification. Automated validations, real-time status updates, and exception alerts were introduced to reduce errors and improve accuracy. User-friendly screens for new deposits, renewals, and closures enhanced staff productivity. Seamless integration with core banking systems enabled faster and more reliable transaction processing. Standardized workflows ensured consistency across teams and strengthened audit readiness. Overall, the solution accelerated processing, minimized errors, boosted staff efficiency, and delivered a
smoother customer experience.
Roles & Responsibilities as a Business Analyst
Collaborated with operations teams to capture requirements for Fixed Deposit creation, renewals, and closures.
Defined functional specifications for input fields like deposit amount, tenure, rate, and debit account validation.
Designed intuitive user screens ensuring ease of use and improved staff productivity. • Documented exception scenarios and real-time alerts to handle data errors and process deviations. • Coordinated with technology teams to enable integration between HWS and core banking systems. • Prepared workflow diagrams and wireframes to streamline FD processing steps. • • Facilitated UAT by drafting test cases, validating results, and ensuring readiness for production rollout. Supported post-implementation reviews to capture feedback and enhance system performance.
Project Title: GWIS (Global Workflow Instruction System) Duration:
July 2022-2024 January
Manual processing of Fixed Deposit and investment instructions across regions led to delays, data entry errors, and compliance risks. To resolve this, GWIS was implemented as a centralized workflow system to capture, validate, and route customer instructions seamlessly. Standardized input screens were designed to ensure uniform data capture of amount, tenure, rate, and debit account details across geographies. Automated validations reduced manual errors and strengthened compliance with regulatory requirements. Approval workflows with multi-level authorization, validations, and exception handling were documented and streamlined. MIS and dashboard reporting within GWIS were introduced to track instruction status, turnaround time, and compliance. This improved visibility, accountability, and operational efficiency across regions. Overall, the project reduced turnaround time by 40%, improved accuracy, enhanced audit trails, and delivered a better customer experience.
Roles & Responsibilities as a Business Analyst
Elicited and documented business requirements for Fixed Deposit and investment instruction workflows. • Designed standardized input screens ensuring uniform data capture across regions. • Defined multi-level approval workflows, exception handling, and compliance checkpoints. • Conducted process mapping and requirement traceability to align business rules with system design. • Partnered with cross-regional stakeholders to harmonize processes and resolve operational gaps. • Prepared functional specifications and wireframes to guide development and configuration. • Validated MIS and dashboard reporting requirements for monitoring turnaround time and compliance. • Jan 2021-2022 June
Elicited and documented business requirements for Fixed Deposit and investment instruction workflows. • Designed standardized input screens ensuring uniform data capture across regions. • Defined multi-level approval workflows, exception handling, and compliance checkpoints. • Conducted process mapping and requirement traceability to align business rules with system design. • Partnered with cross-regional stakeholders to harmonize processes and resolve operational gaps. • Prepared functional specifications and wireframes to guide development and configuration. • Validated MIS and dashboard reporting requirements for monitoring turnaround time and compliance. • Supported implementation by coordinating UAT, reviewing test results, and ensuring readiness for go-live.
Project Title:  MWS (My Work Space)
Manual tracking of customer transactions across multiple legacy systems created inefficiencies, delays, and limited visibility for commercial and global banking clients. To address this, MWS was implemented as a replacement web application for the online banking system, providing a unified platform to view and manage customer transactions. The application enabled secure access for operations teams to check balances, payment status, and transaction history in real time. It offered intuitive dashboards and search functionality to quickly retrieve customer data across regions. Automated validations and exception alerts reduced manual errors and improved accuracy. Seamless integration with core banking systems ensured faster, more reliable transaction updates. Standardized workflows improved consistency across teams and enhanced audit readiness. Overall, MWS improved efficiency, strengthened data accuracy, and delivered a better experience for both staff and customers.
Roles & Responsibilities as a Business Analyst
Gathered requirements from business and operations teams for replacing the legacy online banking system. • Documented functional specifications for transaction search, filters, and customer account visibility. • Designed dashboards and reporting features to enhance monitoring of commercial and global client activity. • Collaborated with technical teams to ensure real-time integration with multiple core banking platforms. • Defined exception handling rules and access controls to strengthen security and compliance. • Created process flow diagrams to map transaction verification steps across customer segments. • Supported SIT/UAT by drafting scenarios, validating outcomes, and logging issues for resolution. • Coordinated post-go-live support to capture feedback and recommend system enhancements.
Non-IT work experience:
Prior to Business Analyst Job I worked as customer service executive in Tech Mahindra (2018-2019). Worked as a Banking operations executive in HSBC (2019-2020)
